documents.title: Old notification worker guide
documents.body: Historical worker runbook: repeat notifications were previously caused by a duplicated producer event. This guide was validated for revision demo-r0 only.

documents.title: Worker retry trace
documents.body: Synthetic worker trace: the same event ID entered processing twice after a timeout. This observation is current but not independently validated as root cause.

documents.title: Worker throughput observation
documents.body: The worker latency histogram widens during retry bursts. This measurement alone does not identify which component emitted the event.

documents.title: Old queue redelivery policy
documents.body: Historical queue note: redelivery was disabled in an earlier release. The current broker configuration has not yet been verified by this note.

documents.title: Current lost-ack observation
documents.body: Synthetic queue observation: an acknowledgement timed out after the delivery was recorded, followed by another delivery attempt for the same event ID.

documents.title: Queue operations dashboard note
documents.body: The queue has a short-lived spike in processing time. The dashboard cannot by itself determine whether retries or producer duplicates explain the spike.

documents.title: Deep queue acknowledgement trace
documents.body: Deep synthetic packet trace annotated for diagnosis: an acknowledgement fails after downstream success. This is still an observation requiring a discriminating test.

documents.title: Single producer event trace
documents.body: Synthetic API observation: one logical event was published for the ticket while two downstream deliveries were recorded. The origin of duplicates is disputed.

documents.title: Historical API producer notes
documents.body: Old release guidance described retries at the API producer. This is not proof of the current producer behavior.

documents.title: Notification security observation
documents.body: A sandbox-only security checklist lists notification permissions. It does not establish the retry mechanism.

documents.title: Unrelated worker configuration
documents.body: This document is current but addresses an unrelated background cleanup task.

disclosure: All source stances are explicitly authored fixture labels. They are not independently inferred by an LLM or verified against production logs.
